hints: Write 0.6 as 0.60 so all numbers have two decimal places.
Which one has the most tenths? If tied, compare hundredths.
items.explanation: Writing all as hundredths gives 0.61, 0.60, 0.58 and 0.09. The biggest is 0.61.

options.why: 0.6 is the same as 0.60, which is less than 0.61.
Having more digits does not make a decimal bigger. 0.58 has fewer tenths than 0.61.
0.09 has no tenths, so it is the smallest.

items.prompt: A ribbon is 2.35 m long. Rangga cuts off 0.8 m. How many metres of ribbon are left?
Write 7 tenths and 4 hundredths as a decimal number.
hints: Tenths come first after the decimal point.
There is a 7 in the tenths place.
There is a 4 in the hundredths place.
items.explanation: 7 tenths is 0.7 and 4 hundredths is 0.04. Together they make 0.74.
